Additional comments

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Easy for us, but we were quite lucky. We rented an airbnb from home, and the landlord had other houses, that she rented out more long term for students.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Very nice to live in Fitzroy or Carlton, but it is often as expensive as the colleges.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: A lot of info, but the online guides were great.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got 3 of 4 classes, I wanted. I think I could have changed to the last one later, but I found another great class.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do everything early. I was late, and got pretty nervous about visa etc.

Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None. Though they are much more outgoing, which was nice

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Much work academically, due to tests throughout semester.
Very beautiful country and friendly people.
Try to find housing with australians, as it can be hard to obtain friends otherwise.
Definetly go.
